lines.text: The LORD says He will pour out His Spirit on all people, and sons and daughters will prophesy.
The LORD says old men will dream dreams and young men will see visions.
The LORD says He will pour out His Spirit even on His priests and Levites in those days.
The LORD will show wonders of blood, fire and smoke, and the sun will turn to darkness and the moon to blood.
Everyone who calls on the LORD's name will be saved, and deliverance will be on Mount Sinai among the remnant.
